participating-org.narrative:
OBOR is a Phnom Penh–based venture capital and advisory firm operating as a comprehensive investment platform focused on supportingthe growth and transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Cambodia and across Southeast Asia. Established in 2016 by a team of experienced investment professionals, OBOR brings together over two decades of expertise in investing, managing, andadvising companies in emerging markets. The organization plays a dual role as both an investor and a strategic partner, targeting high-potential businesses with the capacity to become market leaders while also supporting them to adopt international standards in governance, financial management, and operations.
Over time, OBOR has evolved from a single investment vehicle into an integrated entrepreneurial ecosystem composed of three core entities: OBOR Capital (investment arm), OBOR Management (fund management), and OBOR Advisory (consulting and strategic advisory services). Through this structure, OBOR delivers end-to-end support across the investment lifecycle, including fund management, corporate finance, strategy and business transformation, and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) advisory. The organization’s investment approach focuses on sectors withstrong impact potential such as clean water, waste management, renewable energy, agriculture, logistics, and digital services—particularly those that benefit underserved and ruralcommunities.
In addition to providing capital, OBOR works closely with entrepreneurs as a hands-on partner, offering technical assistance, operational guidance, and access to networks to strengthen business performance and investment readiness. Its model emphasizes combining local market insights with international best practices, enabling businesses to scale sustainably while improving transparency, governance, and long-term resilience. By supporting both financial returns and measurable social and environmental outcomes, OBOR contributes to building a stronger and more inclusive entrepreneurial ecosystem in Cambodia and the broader region.
